title: SignalOS: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common SignalOS failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a drive appears empty, check its label, whether it has records, and whether the target block supports that drive role.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If a drive appears empty, check its label, record list, expected host, install location, and whether the owning addon is present.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
